steps: errors/stats, errors/resolve-all, errors/:id/to-ticket, versions/:id and seven /api/docs/* paths → 404.
title: Admin DevOps console calls 11 routes the backend does not have
expected: Every DevOps console panel loads data from a registered admin route.
actual: Error statistics, bulk resolve, ticket conversion, version detail and the documentation library/search panels fail with 404. /api/docs exposes only GET /.
impact: Admin-only. Operators lose the error-triage and docs tools the console advertises.
fix: Implement the routes behind requireAuth + requireAdmin, or remove the panels. Record which in the DevOps console spec.
